summary: Validated iteration-5 fixes: (1) new visual_mode field ('gradient' default | 'ai'), (2) creation of AI reels succeeds with status='queued' regardless of budget, and (3) root cause of the user-reported 'errors when creating a video' is CONFIRMED to be the LLM key BUDGET CAP (not a code bug). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_reels_fifth_batch.py — 9/9 pytest cases passed in ~13s. POST /api/reels {visual_mode:'ai', script:'An exorcist enters a haunted church at midnight.', voice_id:'onyx'} returns 200 with visual_mode='ai' and status='queued'. POST /api/reels with visual_mode omitted defaults to 'gradient' in the returned reel. GET /api/config returns 200 with voices, voice_speeds, caption_styles (positions/sizes/fonts/anims), bg_themes, bg_motions and music_tracks with exactly 7 entries incl 'none'. Validation still enforced: invalid caption_font->400, invalid music_id->400, custom bg with bad hex->400. Analytics: POST /api/reels/{id}/view and /download correctly increment counters on an existing ready reel and persist on GET. 404s returned for unknown reel ids. BUDGET ROOT-CAUSE CONFIRMATION: the AI reel transitions queued->scripting->voicing then FAILS ONLY at the LLM/image call with the exact backend error `Failed to generate chat completion: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 1.441979250009059, Max budget: 1.4` (captured from backend.err.log and the reel doc's `error` field). This is an ENV/credits issue — not a code exception — and matches the reported user symptom. Frontend (Expo web @ 390x844): Create screen now shows a new 'VISUAL STYLE' segmented toggle with testIDs visual-mode-segment / segment-gradient / segment-ai. Tapping AI IMAGES reveals the helper note 'AI paints story-matching images for your reel (uses a few extra credits per video).' and hiding it when toggling back to GRADIENT works. End-to-end submission verified: switched to PASTE SCRIPT mode, selected AI IMAGES, pasted the exorcist script, tapped Generate Reel (testID generate-reel-button) — the app navigated to /reel/f36a8cff-... progress screen as expected. Leftover test reels were cleaned up.

rca_of_issue: USER-REPORTED BUG ROOT CAUSE: The 'errors when creating a video' message users see is NOT a code exception. It is the pipeline surfacing the Emergent LLM universal-key BUDGET CAP: `Failed to generate chat completion: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 1.441979250009059, Max budget: 1.4`. Reproduction: POST /api/reels with any script (visual_mode gradient or ai) → the reel is created (200, status=queued) → the pipeline hits the LLM for TTS/Whisper/scene-prompts/image and fails at the budgeted API call → reel.status transitions to 'failed' with the budget error in reel.error. Mitigation: (a) raise/reset the LLM key budget on the platform side, then reels generate successfully; (b) optionally add a friendlier UI mapping in reel/[id].tsx for error strings containing 'Budget has been exceeded'.
